info.name: LJVIS — Officer Dashboard (LJVIS2-37)
info.description: Functional tests for the officer dashboard (LJVIS2-37): GET /v1/dashboard/summary (activeCompoundForms/activeStandaloneForms/needsAttention, own vs organisation scope gated by control_form.view_unpublished). The LJVIS2-68 '+ Lisa' menu (classifier+permission-driven available form types) is resolved client-side (FORM_TYPE classifier + permissions already loaded in the SPA — see getAvailableFormKeys in frontend/src/features/control-forms/formRoutes.ts), so it has no dedicated backend endpoint to test here. Self-contained: creates its own compound form + sub-form + standalone forms, confirms one, and cleans up at the end.
